deployments_detail.use: Company-stated strategy prioritizing Digital and AI to rethink customer experience (consumer credit); no named deployed system

Virtual customer assistance / assistant for customer onboarding and support ('assistance et prise en main des clients', 'assistance virtuelle'), described as part of Salafin's AI integration into customer-facing processes. [none disclosed]

Personalized credit scoring for personal loans, including behavioral scoring and custom pre-screening models built and fine-tuned on Salafin data, providing decision support for underwriting/risk control and marketing propensity modeling. [CRIF Decision Solutions]
deployments_detail.value: +19% increase in new personal loan volumes (Nov 2009-Jan 2010) following the campaign using the new models

deployments_detail.use: Deployment of a behavioral scoring model ('score comportemental SALAFIN 2016') used in credit risk decisioning, as disclosed in Salafin's AMMC financial reference document. [none disclosed]
Generative AI to support analysis and processing of customer files as part of Salafin's stated plan to embed AI into its key processes. [none disclosed]
AI used to accelerate the credit decision cycle ('Time-to-Yes' reduction) by compressing friction points in loan approval. [none disclosed]

Online automated credit pre-decisioning: after a customer submits information via the digital application form, Salafin analyzes the file and returns an online 'réponse de principe' (in-principle decision), backed by its scoring engine. [none disclosed]
AI-driven personalization of financing offers to individual customers. [none disclosed]

AI/machine-learning anti-fraud model that scores the probability of fraud on consumer/auto credit applications before disbursement, flagging deceptive transactions, falsified accounts and non-existent businesses. Reported as Morocco's first ML-based fraud detection system of this kind. [AIS Group (Aplicaciones de Inteligencia Artificial, Spain)]
deployments_detail.value: 700 real fraud cases detected in 2017 (baseline); AIS projected a 20-30% improvement in fraud detection
